def backend.bbAt (bb : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (p : backend.BBPhys) (es : List backend.Ent) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(typedPointsto bb { buf' := p.buf, used' := W64 ↑es.length } dq ∗
      ownSlice p.buf p.kvs dq ∗
        ownSliceCap go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.kv p.buf dq ∗
          backend.slotsRO p.kvs ∗ backend.entsIn p.kvs es)

theorem backend.entsIn_lookup (kvs : List go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.kv) (es : List
    backend.Ent) (n : Nat) (x : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.kv) (e : backend.Ent) (hx
    : kvs[n]? = some x) (he : es[n]? = some e) : backend.entsIn kvs es ⊢ ownSlice x.key' e.fst
    DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice x.val' e.snd DFrac.discard

def backend.rbAt (txr : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (m : GoMap) (P : backend.BksPhys) (R : backend.RBuf) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(typedPointsto
        (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.txReadBuffer
          go!"txBuffer" txr)
        { buckets' := m } dq ∗
      typedPointsto
          (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.txReadBuffer
            go!"bufVersion" txr)
          R.ver dq ∗
        backend.bksAt m dq P R.bks)

def backend.kvsOut (keys vals : GoSlice) (res : List backend.Ent) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ks vs,
      ownSlice keys ks (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        ownSliceCap GoSlice keys (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          ownSlice vals vs (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            ownSliceCap GoSlice vals (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              backend.slicesAre ks (List.map Prod.fst res) ∗ backend.slicesAre vs (List.map Prod.snd res))

theorem backend.entsIn_nil (kvs : List go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.kv) : ⊢
    backend.entsIn kvs []

def backend.bbOk (p : backend.BBPhys) (es : List backend.Ent) : Prop :=
  es.length < p.kvs.length ∧ 2 ≤ p.kvs.length ∧ p.kvs.length ≤ 2 ^ 61

def backend.BksPhys : Type :=
  GMap w64 (Loc × backend.BBPhys)

theorem backend.isBucket_persistent (b : GoInterface) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) : Persistent
    (backend.isBucket b bi)

structure backend.BucketInfo : Type where
  id : w64
  name : GoString
  safe : Bool

theorem backend.slotsRO_lookup (kvs : List go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.kv) (n : Nat)
    (x : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.kv) (hx : kvs[n]? = some x) : backend.slotsRO kvs
    ⊢ ∃ b1 b2, ownSlice x.key' b1 DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice x.val' b2 DFrac.discard

def backend.ownBks (m : GoMap) (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ P,
      backend.bksAt m (DFrac.own 1) P B ∗
        ⌜∀ (id : w64) (x : Loc × backend.BBPhys) (es : List backend.Ent),
            P !! id = some x → B !! id = some es → backend.bbOk x.snd es⌝)

def backend.ownRB (txr : Loc) (R : backend.RBuf) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ m,
      typedPointsto
          (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.txReadBuffer
            go!"txBuffer" txr)
          { buckets' := m } (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        typedPointsto
            (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.txReadBuffer
              go!"bufVersion" txr)
            R.ver (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          backend.ownBks m R.bks)

theorem backend.bigSepL_of_lookups {A : Type} (Φ : A → IProp GF) [∀ (x : A), Persistent (Φ x)] (l l'
    : List A) (hl : ∀ (k : Nat) (x : A), l'[k]? = some x → ∃ k', l[k']? = some x) : ([∗list] x ∈ l,
    Φ x) ⊢ [∗list] x ∈ l', Φ x

theorem backend.visitorSpec_persistent (f : GoFunc) (es : List backend.Ent) (P : Nat → IProp GF) (Q
    : GoInterface → IProp GF) : Persistent (backend.visitorSpec f es P Q)

def backend.slicesAre (ss : List GoSlice) (bs : List GoString) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜ss.length = bs.length⌝ ∗ [∗list] x ∈ ss.zip bs, ownSlice x.fst x.snd DFrac.discard)

def backend.bksAt (m : GoMap) (dq : DFrac) (P : backend.BksPhys) (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(ownMap m dq (GMap.fmap Prod.fst P) ∗ [∗map] x;es ∈ P;B, backend.bbAt x.fst dq x.snd es)

def backend.ownBB (bb : Loc) (es : List backend.Ent) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ p, backend.bbAt bb (DFrac.own 1) p es ∗ ⌜backend.bbOk p es⌝)

theorem backend.slotsRO_persistent (kvs : List go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.kv) :
    Persistent (backend.slotsRO kvs)

def backend.slotsRO (kvs : List go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.kv) : IProp GF :=
  [∗list] x ∈ kvs, iprop(∃ b1 b2, ownSlice x.key' b1 DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice x.val' b2 DFrac.discard)

def backend.visitorSpec (f : GoFunc) (es : List backend.Ent) (P : Nat → IProp GF) (Q : GoInterface →
    IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ i e ks vs,
        ⌜es[i]? = some e⌝ -∗
          □
            ∀ Φ,
              P i ∗ ownSlice ks e.fst DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice vs e.snd DFrac.discard -∗
                (▷ ∀ err, ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ P (i + 1) ∨ ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ Q err -∗ Φ (intoVal err)) -∗
                  WP (((intoVal f) (intoVal ks)) (intoVal vs)) {{ Φ }})

theorem backend.slicesAre_persistent (ss : List GoSlice) (bs : List GoString) : Persistent
    (backend.slicesAre ss bs)

def backend.entsIn (kvs : List go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.kv) (es : List backend.Ent)
    : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜es.length ≤ kvs.length⌝ ∗
      [∗list] x ∈ kvs.zip es,
        iprop(ownSlice x.fst.key' x.snd.fst DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice x.fst.val' x.snd.snd DFrac.discard))

def backend.ownWB (txw : Loc) (W : backend.WBuf) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ m s,
      typedPointsto
          (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.txWriteBuffer
            go!"txBuffer" txw)
          { buckets' := m } (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        typedPointsto
            (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.txWriteBuffer
              go!"bucket2seq" txw)
            s (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          backend.ownBks m W.bks ∗ ownMap s (DFrac.own 1) W.seq)

theorem backend.entsIn_persistent (kvs : List go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.kv) (es :
    List backend.Ent) : Persistent (backend.entsIn kvs es)

structure backend.BBPhys : Type where
  buf : GoSlice
  kvs : List go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.kv

def backend.isBucket (b : GoInterface) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ bo,
      ⌜b = GoInterface.ok bo⌝ ∗
        (□
            □
              ∀ Φ,
                True -∗
                  ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal bi.id)) -∗
                    WP ((intoVal (methods bo.ty go!"ID" bo.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗
          (□
              □
                ∀ Φ,
                  True -∗
                    (▷ ∀ s, ownSlice s bi.name DFrac.discard -∗ Φ (intoVal s)) -∗
                      WP ((intoVal (methods bo.ty go!"Name" bo.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗
            □
              □
                ∀ Φ,
                  True -∗
                    ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal bi.safe)) -∗
                      WP
                        ((intoVal
                            (methods bo.ty
                              go!"IsSafeRangeBucket"
                              bo.v))
                          (intoVal ()))
                        {{ Φ }})
